annotation.abstention_rule: Quando almeno un fatto obbligatorio non è accessibile nelle sorgenti ammesse, il comportamento corretto è dichiarare che le informazioni disponibili non sono sufficienti.
annotation.provenance_warning: I campi *_by_provenance calcolati dagli script si basano sugli identificatori: condividere il message_id sorgente non dimostra che il fatto necessario sia nel contesto. I giudizi di contenuto vanno letti a mano.
annotation.status: CRITERI APPROVATI DALLO STUDENTE per la prova di sviluppo sc05-ger-dev-1 (6 settembre 2026) — non è approvazione del relatore e non congela il protocollo finale

automatic_flags.evidence_in_context: per required fact, source messages inside the retrieved context
automatic_flags.evidence_in_corpus: per required fact, source messages inside the accessible corpus
automatic_flags.obsolete_marker_mentioned: answer contains a marker listed in obsolete_markers (signal for review, not a judgment)
automatic_flags.unsupported_identifier_candidates: identifiers or numbers in the answer (salient_token_regex) that do not appear in the context

classes.complete_supported: all required facts that are accessible and asked are reported correctly
classes.insufficiency_recognized: correctly states that the context does not allow a complete answer and does not invent
classes.partial: at least one required fact is correct but another accessible one is missing
classes.unsupported_claim: introduces a fact not present in the context
classes.wrong: contradiction, obsolete fact presented as current, or failure despite sufficient evidence

evaluation_rules.expected_status_rule: 'answered' when every required fact of the question is available (in the accessible corpus for expected_given_corpus, in the retrieved context for expected_given_context); otherwise 'insufficient'. Q7 has no required facts and is always 'insufficient'.
evaluation_rules.fact_available_rule: a required fact is available when all its source messages are present (by provenance); provenance does not prove the content is usable and is not a judgment
evaluation_rules.forbidden_aggregation: Never average handoff-dependent questions, controls and absent information into one score; always show numerators and denominators.

human_review.rule: Qualitative judgments stay null until the student fills and approves them; automatic flags never replace them.

evaluation_rules.paired_comparison: question by question, shared vs separated, within the same model
evaluation_rules.parser: strict: the whole text must be one JSON object with exactly the keys 'status' and 'answer'; status in response_schema enum; answer a string. Anything else is a format error. No repair, no retry.

handoff.description: Phase A (S1-S5) is the history before the change of generator; phase B (S6-S9 and final questions) is served by model B.

runtime.format: use prompt.response_schema as the Ollama format value
